description: prHourlyLimit 0 lifts config:recommended's 2 PRs/hour throttle that parked cert-manager/cnpg/KSM in the dashboard Rate-Limited list, so every detected in-cluster update opens a PR.

customManagers.description: Container images in k8s manifests, incl. non-standard fields (e.g. CNPG spec.imageName)

packageRules.description: Digest-pin ONLY the un-versionable tags (latest/git-sha/rolling) so Renovate can still track them. Pinning every image hammered docker.io and errored the pin-dependencies PR on Mend; semver-tagged images track fine by tag.
